web.markdown:
[Skip to content](https://progressiverockcentral.com/resources/progressive-rock-festivals/#site-content-contain)

**Directory of active progressive rock festivals**.

**Crescendo Festival**

[Crescendo Festival](http://www.festival-crescendo.com/) is an annual progressive rock festival held in France. The first Crescendo Festival took place in the “Palais des Congrès” in Royan ( in 1999. The Festival now takes place every summer at the “Esplanade du Concié”, outdoors, in the oceanfront at Saint‑Palais‑sur‑Mer (western France).

**ProgDay**

[ProgDay](http://www.progday.net/) is one of the world’s longest running progressive rock festivals. The festival takes place in September at Storybook Farm, Chapel Hill, in North Carolina, USA.

**RoSfest**

[Rites of Spring Festival (RoSfest)](http://rosfest.com/) is an annual progressive rock festival held in Gettysburg (Pennsylvania), USA.

**Seaprog**

[Seaprog](http://seaprogfest.org/) is an annual progressive rock festival held in Seattle, Washington state.

[Facebook](https://progressiverockcentral.com/#facebook "Facebook") [Mastodon](https://progressiverockcentral.com/#mastodon "Mastodon") [Email](https://progressiverockcentral.com/#email "Email") [Share](https://www.addtoany.com/share#url=https%3A%2F%2Fprogressiverockcentral.com%2Fresources%2Fprogressive-rock-festivals%2F&title=Progressive%20Rock%20Festivals)

## 4 Replies to “Progressive Rock Festivals”

1. Am an old progressive rock fan who loves the top tier bands like Yes, ELP, Pink Floyd as well as 2nd tier groups such as Gentle Giant, UK, Dregs, Happy the Man, Bruford, Hatfield, PFM, Holdsworth, National Health among many others who didn’t get as much recognition in the U.S.



I’m realizing that those performers are disappearing quickly in recent times. Would like to get any info on prog happenings of this I’ll in the U.S.

2. 2nd tier?

3. love it but the next one!!!!

4. Hi, I’m with the Seaprog Central Committee, and I’d like you to know that we’ve got a new event coming up in June. We call it Cascadence, and we’ll be featuring Gong, Khu.eex’, Rachel Flowers, and Kathy Moore Super Power featuring Julie Slick. Pre-festival event is the album release party for Moon Letters along with a Julie Slick solo show and local art-rock band Kitsune.
